title: S3d cache-aware handoff economics: cached context retained or lost, uncached reconstruction, packet tokens, duplicated evidence and latency per handoff; effective handoff cost recorded on routing rows in shadow (P32)
spec:
orchestrator/handoff_scorecard.py: for every handoff pair the scorecard already tracks (Opus to Fable planner escalation, executor to stronger executor via fallback or fix round on another model, worker to replacement worker after cancel or re-file), add per handoff: cached_context_retained (cache_read_tokens of the successor's first run), cache_lost (predecessor's last-run cache_read_tokens minus the successor's first-run cache_read_tokens, floored at 0), uncached_reconstruction (successor first-run input_uncached_tokens), handoff_packet_tokens (successor packet_meta chars/4), duplicated_evidence (evidence ids present in both packets' packet_meta evidence lists), latency_s (gap between predecessor end and successor first event) and effective_handoff_cost = uncached_reconstruction + cache_lost*read_ratio + handoff_packet_tokens using cache_telemetry ratios. `orchestrator scorecard --handoffs` shows the new columns and medians per handoff kind. Handoff routing decision rows (the existing kind used by the handoff router) gain effective_handoff_cost per candidate in shadow; routing itself unchanged (no mode flip in this task). Docs: docs/hermes-hardening/18-handoff-economics.md with numbers measured read-only against the main checkout where rows exist, and the statement that pre-task rows lack the cache fields.
Repository rules: unittest (not pytest), tests/_harness.py single ORCH_ROOT fixture; every acceptance test id tests/test_<module>.py::test_name is a method def test_name(self) in a unittest.TestCase. No new third-party dependencies. Never write secret values to any file or log; test fixtures use synthetic names and values that are not credential-shaped. Do not quote template placeholder tokens (double braces) anywhere in code comments or docs. Shadow-first: a new adaptive path never changes what a worker sees until its mode is active; shadow only writes decision_log or runs rows. Task worktrees carry no .orchestrator runs, tasks or decision_log state: tests use synthetic fixtures; for any measured numbers in docs run read-only against /Users/k3ntaw/code/orchestrator/.orchestrator via an explicit root argument. Run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh . until green; the base suite must stay green. Do not ask questions: decide, and note decisions in the result summary. Contracts of the earlier modules: .orchestrator/plan.md (section GOAL T-0991) and docs/hermes-hardening/*.md on this branch; read the merged modules before building on them.
